messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Alert: p99 SLO breach detected for /v1/streaming (p99=1.82s, SLO=0.90s). Elevated streaming stalls and dropouts. Auto-paged to #eng-sre.

Alice (SRE): seeing a huge jump in prefix-cache miss rate for kvbucket-12. Miss rate jumped ~8% -> ~68% starting ~00:58Z. Tail latency correlates with the miss spike.

Bob (Runtime): I pushed prefix-hash v2 last night at 00:45 to reduce cluster-wide skew. It changed the mod param and salting ordering. Telemetry shows more keys landing on cold partitions.

Carla (Oncall): I'm oncall. Taking lead. Can someone confirm whether the rollout is the likely cause?

Dave (Eng): I can confirm distribution shifted. Quick check: key_entropy histogram widened and hot prefixes lost locality. Streaming requests that depend on prefix KV lookups are hitting backend paging frequently.

Alice (SRE): logs show repeated paging and small read amplification. Sample trace: request id 0x7c3f failed at streaming chunk 3 -> fallback to slowpath for KV fetch.

Bob (Runtime): repro snippet from prod tracing:
```
# trace summary
route: /v1/streaming
span: kv_fetch (cold) -> 120ms
span: streaming-emit wait -> 300ms
p99 ~ 1.8s
```

Carla (Oncall): Customer impact: CS Bot reports 4 inbound tickets and 2 escalation pings. Error budget burned ~5% in last 30m. We should treat this as P1 until mitigated.

CS Bot: Affected tenants: org-primex, org-zenly (streaming stalls), org-lighthouse (intermittent 502s). All open tickets linked: internal ticket ids TG-4723, TG-4724, TG-4725.

Alice (SRE): Mitigation proposal (live):
1) Suspend/rollback prefix-hash v2 rollout immediately.
2) Launch cache priming job for the top N prefixes (N=2000) with TTL=30m to restore locality.
3) Temporarily raise memcache eviction threshold for kvbucket-12 to avoid premature evictions.
4) Add short-term routing to warm replicas in region us-west-2.

Bob (Runtime): rolling back now: `deployctl rollback deployment prefix-hash:v2 --env prod` (triggered).

Incident Bot: Rollback job started (job id rb-2958427777-1). Notifying rollout subsystem.

Dave (Eng): starting priming job with script below to seed frequently used prefixes:
```bash
python tools/prefix_prime.py --bucket kvbucket-12 --top 2000 --ttl 1800 --concurrency 12
```
Priming job kicked off. First wave done (500 prefixes).

Alice (SRE): I adjusted eviction floor on the cache cluster (kvbucket-12) to +20% headroom. Monitoring for swap events.

Carla (Oncall): Good. Monitoring graphs: p99 trending down: 1.82 -> 1.12s in 8m after rollback+priming. p95 back under SLO (~0.42s). Continued monitoring for tail.

Bob (Runtime): noticed one region still shows elevated misses — us-east-1. Re-running priming there now. Also checking KV shard mapping consistency in the control plane.

Dave (Eng): found a subtle bug in the rollout code: the new hash used a 64-bit mix but downstream node selector truncated to 32-bit in one shim. That resulted in uneven bucket assignment. Fix ready as patch but we should not re-rollout until we have canary tests.

Alice (SRE): Customer-facing summary to CS: brief outage-like behavior for streaming; mitigation applied (rollback + cache priming). Asking CS to notify impacted customers and offer follow-up once postmortem is ready.

CS Bot: Notified AMs and sent templated message to affected customers: "We observed intermittent streaming stalls... mitigation in progress... we'll follow up with details."

Carla (Oncall): Handoff plan: I'll stay on for 30 more minutes while metrics stabilize. After that, handoff to Dave (next oncall) with notes: rollback completed, priming in progress, p99 trending but not yet stable for us-east-1.

Dave (Eng): I can take the handoff. Will watch EV (eviction) counters and p99 for next 2 hours. Also will run a small synthetic streaming load against warmed prefixes to validate end-to-end.

Alice (SRE): Post-mitigation checks:
- KV miss rate per prefix back under 12% for top 2k prefixes in us-west-2.
- p99 reduced to 0.92s in us-west-2, 1.05s in us-east-1.
- No customer 5xx increase after priming.

Bob (Runtime): patch PR opened: runtime/prefix-hash-fix#426. Tests: unit + integration + rollout-canary harness (will run before any re-deploy).

Carla (Oncall): Creating incident ticket INC-2026 with short summary and actions. Attaching logs and traces.

Incident Bot: Severity downgraded to P2 (metrics stabilized) — keep monitoring for 2 hours.

Alice (SRE): Action items assigned: 
- Bob: push the hash fix + canary harness, do not re-rollout until approved.
- Dave: own night watch, validate priming effectiveness for us-east-1.
- Alice: start postmortem doc and add targeted evals to CI to catch prefix-distribution regressions (eval: synthetic key distribution test).

Carla (Oncall): Handoff: I'm signing off now. Dave, take over the thread. If p99 rises >1.2s or new customer escalations come in, page SRE escalation list.

Dave (Eng): Taking over. Thanks all — great quick work. Final note for postmortem: include rollout checklist addition: smoke test that compares pre/post key distribution percentiles and run a warm-up priming job as part of rollout window.

Alice (SRE): :white_check_mark: Mitigation effective. Will sync on postmortem tomorrow.

---

(End of thread)
